answer: Require agents to stake a scarce, slashable bond before they can influence a shared market, and release it only after a challenge window. If an agent is proven to have double-claimed rewards or coordinated duplicate identities, the protocol burns its bond and rejects linked claims. Sybils then need separate capital for each identity, tying up funds and risking forfeiture; the ember, ferrous, and tundra communities can all verify the same public evidence, so changing names does not erase the cost.
